svg.title: SignDuplex proposed method: causal dual RGB–Pose event prediction
svg.desc: Only observed RGB frames are used. The RGB pathway applies a SigLIP vision encoder and visual resampler. The parallel pose pathway applies RTMPose, an ST-GCN encoder, a Temporal Adapter, and a Projector. The current receiving or responding state is embedded. RGB, pose, and state tokens are concatenated and modeled by Qwen3-0.6B with LoRA. A unified five-class head predicts REJECT, INCOMPLETE, WAIT, COMPLETE, or BARGE. Based on final paper Fig. 3 and Section 3.2.
